20261121-chemistry-g07-1.s.s1.explain:
Isinyathelo 1: $[\text{H}^+]_A = 10^{-3}\text{ M}$, $[\text{H}^+]_B = 10^{-5}\text{ M}$.
Isinyathelo 2: Isilinganiso $\frac{1.0 \times 10^{-3}}{1.0 \times 10^{-5}} = 10^2 = 100$.

20261122-chemistry-g08-1.s.s1.explain:
Isinyathelo 1: Ngokomthetho ka-Avogadro, ivolumu $V = n \times V_m$.
Isinyathelo 2: $V = 0.2\text{ mol} \times 24.5\text{ L/mol}$.
Isinyathelo 3: Ukubala kunikeza u-$V = 4.90\text{ L}$.

20261122-chemistry-g08-2.title: Atoms and Ions
20261122-chemistry-g08-2.goal: Sebenzisa izimiso ze-Atoms and Ions ukuxazulula inkinga yophenyo.
20261122-chemistry-g08-2.material: [M2 Uphenyo Lwekhemistri (Okuthuthukile)] Inkinga yokuhlaziya ubungako mayelana ne-Atoms and Ions. Isixazululo se-asidi $A$ sinokusansimbi $[\text{H}^+] = 1.0 \times 10^{-3}\text{ M}$ kanti isixazululo $B$ sino-$[\text{H}^+] = 1.0 \times 10^{-5}\text{ M}$. Kaphindwe kangaki ukugcwala kwe-ion ye-hydrogen ku-$A$ kukhulu kune-B?
20261122-chemistry-g08-2.s.s1.prompt: [M2 Uphenyo Lwekhemistri (Okuthuthukile)] Inkinga yokuhlaziya ubungako mayelana ne-Atoms and Ions. Isixazululo se-asidi $A$ sinokusansimbi $[\text{H}^+] = 1.0 \times 10^{-3}\text{ M}$ kanti isixazululo $B$ sino-$[\text{H}^+] = 1.0 \times 10^{-5}\text{ M}$. Kaphindwe kangaki ukugcwala kwe-ion ye-hydrogen ku-$A$ kukhulu kune-B?
20261122-chemistry-g08-2.s.s1.explain:
Isinyathelo 1: $[\text{H}^+]_A = 10^{-3}\text{ M}$, $[\text{H}^+]_B = 10^{-5}\text{ M}$.
Isinyathelo 2: Isilinganiso $\frac{1.0 \times 10^{-3}}{1.0 \times 10^{-5}} = 10^2 = 100$.
Isinyathelo 3: Ukugcwala kuka-$A$ kukhulu ngokuphindwe ka-100 kune-B.
